user.description: Transcribes Assist voice requests with AssemblyAI's streaming models while you speak. Get an API key at assemblyai.com.

reauth_confirm.description: AssemblyAI rejected the saved API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach AssemblyAI. Check the connection and try again.

data.finish_on_end_of_turn: Stop listening when AssemblyAI hears the end of the sentence

data_description.model: Universal-3.6 Pro Realtime is the most accurate. Universal-Streaming English costs a third as much.
data_description.keyterms: Words to recognize more reliably, one per line, up to 100. A small, focused list (your room names and the few device names you say most) usually works better than a long list of everything. Free on Universal-3.6 Pro; $0.04/hour extra on Universal-Streaming English.
data_description.fallback_stt: Used when AssemblyAI can't be reached, rejects the request (for example because another request is already streaming), or doesn't answer in time. The audio heard so far is passed to this engine, so nothing needs repeating.
data_description.finish_on_end_of_turn: Off: listen until your voice assistant detects silence, as with other engines. On: return the text as soon as AssemblyAI decides you've finished, which can be quicker but may cut off a request if you pause mid-sentence.

simulate_failure.name: Simulate failure
simulate_failure.description: Makes the next requests fail before reaching AssemblyAI, to test the fallback engine.

count.name: Count
count.description: How many requests in a row should fail.
